user.title: Connect Hospitable
user.description: Enter a Hospitable Personal Access Token from Apps > API access. Public API access requires a paid Hospitable plan; Essentials is excluded. The token needs read access to user, property, reservation, and calendar data.

properties.title: Select properties
properties.description: Choose at least one property to monitor.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Hospitable token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement Personal Access Token for this Hospitable account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Hospitable. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Generate a replacement under Apps > API access, and confirm the account has paid Public API access.
error.option_bound: The value is outside the permitted bound.

abort.already_configured: This Hospitable account is already configured.
abort.no_properties: No properties were found for this account.
abort.wrong_account: The replacement token belongs to a different account.

init.title: Hospitable options
init.description: Tune polling and property selection. Wider windows increase requests; shorter lookback can hide long in-progress stays.

error.invalid_timezone: Timezone overrides must be IANA names such as America/Los_Angeles.
error.option_bound: The value is outside the permitted bound.
